headline: China’s Economic Growth Relies on Strong Exports Amid Domestic Slump
summary: Official statistics show China's economic growth sustained by strong exports while facing a prolonged housing crash, sluggish consumer spending, and plunging investment.
why: China is the world's second-largest economy; sustained export performance acts as a vital buffer against domestic real estate and consumer weakness.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: While robust external demand supports overall GDP growth, weak domestic consumption and a property downturn pose structural risks.
